about: Links areas of shared Edge CMS code to the documents that describe how they behave, so a change to the code is checked against what the skills, contracts and guides say (edge-skill-impact skill, edge/tests/skillImpact.test.mjs). Paths are relative to the Hub checkout; documents with a repo live in that sibling checkout (../<repo>). `code` entries are globs; `diffPattern` narrows a file to changes whose diff lines match it. `says` is what the document claims, so a reviewer knows what to test. `probe` is a script that shows the real behavior.
